entry.name: PetalStormFlavor
entry.value: The Giant Audrey II uses its petals like grenade shardes to decimate its enemies from afar

entry.name: SpiritLightningFlavor
entry.value: The Dryads summon flashes of lightning to destroy their enemies.

entry.name: DeathWailFlavor
entry.value: The Mutants let out an almighty roar that means instant death to the weak minded.

entry.name: ParasiticalBreathFlavor
entry.value: The Octopoda Facientem use their oil clouds filled with parasites that can strip flesh from bone.

entry.name: SeismicVoidFlavor
entry.value: Stone fractures and ores flash burn into silvered steam as the Psyker drags up tides of magma from deep below.

entry.name: SkyFallFlavor
entry.value: Savagely beautiful orbs of coruscating light plummet from the cold depths of space, growing to roaring bale-stars as they approach.

entry.name: HellBreathFlavor
entry.value: A torrent of psychic flames pour forth from the psyker's eyes and mouth, engulfing the target.

entry.name: HellBeamFlavor
entry.value: The Daemon summons a white-hot beam of blazing energy. It melts armour to slag and vaporises flesh, leaving only ghastly shadows in its wake.
